enum.name: FUEL_CELL_CONTROL_COMMAND
enum.description: Persistent FCS start/stop command sent to the fuel cell controller.

entry.name: FUEL_CELL_CONTROL_COMMAND_OFF
entry.description: Turn the fuel cell controller off.

entry.name: FUEL_CELL_CONTROL_COMMAND_ON
entry.description: Turn the fuel cell controller on.

enum.name: FUEL_CELL_DEVICE_STATE
enum.description: FCS system state reported by the fuel cell controller over CAN.

enum.name: FUEL_CELL_CONNECTION_STATE
enum.description: State of the fuel cell controller connection.

entry.name: FUEL_CELL_CONNECTION_STATE_NEVER_CONNECTED
entry.description: No valid device status frame has been received.

entry.name: FUEL_CELL_CONNECTION_STATE_ERROR_OCCURRED
entry.description: The device was previously connected, but communication is currently lost.

message.name: FUEL_CELL_CONTROL
message.description: Set the persistent FCS start/stop command. Bus voltage, bus current and requested power are determined by the flight controller and cannot be modified by this message. New requests are temporarily rejected unless the CAN device connection is healthy.
message.field: Non-zero request identifier generated by the sender. Retries must use the same identifier and command. Only the most recent request is cached, keyed by sender system/component and request identifier; duplicate requests return the original result without applying the command again.
System ID of the target vehicle. Zero broadcasts to all systems.
Component ID of the target autopilot. Zero broadcasts to all components.

message.name: FUEL_CELL_STATUS
message.description: Fuel cell controller connection, bus values, FCS state and command processing result. Published every 200 ms even when the CAN device is not connected, and immediately after connection changes or control request processing. Device state and SOC are valid only while connection_state is OK. Receivers should mark this telemetry unavailable if no status is received for 1 second.
message.field: Request ID associated with control_result. Zero means no request has been processed.
Flight-controller-owned bus voltage currently used in CAN control frames, in 0.1 V. Read-only telemetry, not a device acknowledgement.
Flight-controller-owned bus current currently used in CAN control frames, in 0.1 A. Read-only telemetry, not a device acknowledgement.
Flight-controller-owned requested power currently used in CAN control frames. Read-only telemetry, not a device acknowledgement.
Last valid device lithium battery state of charge, in 0.1 percent. Valid only while connection_state is OK.
Last valid FCS system state. Valid only while connection_state is OK.
FCS command currently saved and sent by the flight controller. Actual device operation is reported by device_state.

Processing result for response_request_id. ACCEPTED means that the flight controller saved the command, not that the device completed the operation. TEMPORARILY_REJECTED means that the CAN device is not connected. DENIED means that a cached request identifier was reused with a different command. UNSUPPORTED means that the command is invalid.
Current fuel cell controller connection state.
